If you experience discomfort when you use iPhone while riding as a passenger in a car or other on-road vehicle, you can turn on Vehicle Motion Cues—onscreen cues that may help reduce motion sickness. Vehicle Motion Cues appear as animated dots on the edges of the screen that represent how the vehicle is moving without interfering with what you’re doing on iPhone.

Note: Vehicle Motion Cues should not be used while operating a moving vehicle and in other situations requiring attention to safety. For important information about avoiding distractions that could lead to dangerous situations, see Important safety information for iPhone. Vehicle Motion Cues work best when you’re seated facing forward in the vehicle.

Use iPhone more comfortably while riding in a vehicle

  1. Go to the Settings app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Accessibility, then tap Motion.

  3. Tap Vehicle Motion Cues, then tap an option. If you choose Automatic, animated dots appear on the screen when iPhone detects that you’re riding in a car or other on-road vehicle; the dots are hidden when the motion stops.

  4. To manually show or hide Vehicle Motion Cues, open Control Center, tap , then tap an option.

Customize Vehicle Motion Cues

  1. Go to the Settings app on your iPhone.

  2. Tap Accessibility, then tap Motion.

  3. Tap Vehicle Motion Cues, then tap Customize Appearance.

  4. Customize any of the following:

    • Pattern: Select Regular for a stable and predictable pattern, or Dynamic for a more engaging visual experience.

    • Color: Select a color. Color saturation will automatically adjust to maintain contrast with the content behind each dot.

    • Visibility: Select Larger Dots to increase the size of the dots or More Dots to increase the number of dots.

如果您在乘坐汽车或其他公路车辆时使用 iPhone 时感到不适，您可以打开车辆运动提示 - 屏幕上的提示可能有助于减少晕动病。 车辆运动提示在屏幕边缘显示为动画点，代表车辆的移动方式，而不会干扰您在 iPhone 上进行的操作。

注意：在操作移动的车辆和其他需要注意安全的情况下不应使用车辆运动提示。 有关避免可能导致危险情况的干扰的重要信息，请参阅 iPhone 的重要安全信息。 当您面朝前方坐在车内时，车辆运动提示效果最佳。

乘车时更舒适地使用 iPhone

  1. 转到 iPhone 上的“设置”应用。
  2. 轻点“辅助功能”，然后轻点“动作”。
  3. 轻点“车辆运动提示”，然后轻点一个选项。 如果您选择“自动”，当 iPhone 检测到您正在乘坐汽车或其他道路车辆时，屏幕上会出现动画点；当运动停止时，点被隐藏。
  4. 要手动显示或隐藏车辆运动提示，请打开控制中心，点击 ，然后点击一个选项。

自定义车辆运动提示

  1. 转到 iPhone 上的“设置”应用。
  2. 轻点“辅助功能”，然后轻点“动作”。
  3. 轻点“车辆运动提示”，然后轻点“自定义外观”。
  4. 自定义以下任意一项：图案：选择常规以获得稳定且可预测的图案，或选择动态以获得更具吸引力的视觉体验。颜色：选择颜色。 颜色饱和度将自动调整，以保持与每个点后面的内容的对比度。可见性：选择“较大点”以增加点的大小，或选择“更多点”以增加点的数量。
